directionStats.angleDefinition: Acute angle from projected local surface vertical in metre-scale H/Y charts; vertical <=15 degrees. Flow sheets and preserved seal/crater pools are not vein segments.

comparison.method: Direct side-by-side pixel paste of actual Unity renders; same geometry, camera, shader snapshot, material values and execution frame; only v2/v3 atlas pair switched. No recolouring, resizing or AI editing.

mobileImport.material: Unlit/Texture; shading/AO baked. Main atlas contains its small glow accents; emissive mask is optional for the host.
mobileImport.highQualityOption: The authoring main atlas is 4096px. Raise the import maximum only after profiling a target phone.
mobileImport.estimateNote: Texture storage estimate only; excludes meshes, render buffers, driver overhead, game/UI, camera capture and tracking. Not a measured device memory figure.
